_readme: One entry per voice in lines.json (key = character id). Fill voice_id with a voice from your ElevenLabs account (My Voices, or a Voice Library voice you added). Only stock/library/designed voices: never clone a real person. node voices/render.mjs --suggest <id> searches the Voice Library with library_search + gender/age/accent; --design <id> makes Voice Design previews from description. fallback_voice_id = legacy premade voices (IDs from public lists, NOT verified: used only with --use-fallbacks). fx = the filter the game adds (pa/radio/megaphone/muffled); never bake it into the clip. settings go to voice_settings as-is (speed 0.7-1.2).

crash-cam-kev.speaker: Crash Cam Kev
crash-cam-kev.description: An over-the-top Australian sports commentator calling a demolition derby: fast, loud, gleeful, broad Aussie accent, big rises on the punchlines, like a footy caller who has had three coffees.

oberst-klaus.speaker: Oberst Klaus
oberst-klaus.description: Oberst Klaus, a theatrical German panzer officer in his fifties with an extremely thick, exaggerated German accent: rolling R's, 'ze' and 'zis', crisp barked consonants, grandly polite and menacing, savouring every word like a cartoon villain.
oberst-klaus.note: 2026-11-16: designed voice retired to free a voice slot (Starter plan, 10 max) after all 123 lines were recorded with it. Any NEW Klaus line uses this library voice (Derby - Oberst Klaus), which sounds similar but not identical.

tony-cement.speaker: Tony Cement
tony-cement.description: Tony Cement, a loud New Jersey Italian-American wise guy in his fifties with an extremely thick Brooklyn/Jersey accent: nasal, gravelly, fast-talking, waving his hands, a cartoon mobster who throws in Italian words, menacing but hilarious.
tony-cement.library_search: italian american new york gangster wise guy

big-bertha.speaker: Big Bertha
big-bertha.description: A sweet-as-pie Southern grandma from Georgia with a steel spine: warm honeyed drawl, "sugar" and "bless your heart", sassy and loud when riled.
big-bertha.fallback_voice_name: Grace (Southern American woman; younger than ideal)
big-bertha.library_voice: Grandma Rachel - Wise Southern Senior (us southern)

bulldozer-bob.speaker: Bulldozer Bob
bulldozer-bob.description: Bulldozer Bob, a huge booming West Texas oilfield foreman: enormous, loud, deep voice with a very thick slow Texas drawl, hollering over diesel engines, larger than life, cheerful and bossy like a cartoon cowboy giant.
bulldozer-bob.library_search: texas cowboy deep gravelly blue collar

captain-mccaffrey.speaker: Captain McCaffrey
captain-mccaffrey.description: Captain Maeve McCaffrey, a Dublin-born Chicago fire captain: warm Irish brogue gone hoarse from shouting orders, bossy, brave and funny.

sheriff-buck.speaker: Sheriff Buck
sheriff-buck.role: Police cruiser: Sheriff Dolly Mae Buck (and the megaphone)
sheriff-buck.description: Sheriff Dolly Mae Buck, a loud, brash Deep South county sheriff: thick drawl, big personality, sugar-sweet until she starts yelling.
sheriff-buck.note: MEGA lines get the megaphone filter in game: same voice.

ragnar-rustbeard.speaker: Ragnar Rustbeard
ragnar-rustbeard.description: A gigantic, bellowing Viking raider in his fifties with a huge barrel chest, speaking English with a very thick, exaggerated Norwegian Scandinavian accent: thunderous booming bass, rolling R's, roaring with laughter, theatrical and larger-than-life like a cartoon Viking chieftain shouting across a battlefield.

emeka-danfo.speaker: Emeka Danfo
emeka-danfo.description: A booming, joyful Nigerian man in his forties, a Lagos danfo bus driver turned dune-buggy daredevil, speaking very fast Nigerian English with a rich, thick Nigerian accent and pidgin: huge warm belly laugh, flamboyant showman energy, loud, theatrical, fast-talking and full of joy. Original character.

maxine-mactavish.speaker: Maxine MacTavish
maxine-mactavish.description: A fierce, roaring Scottish Highland woman in her forties speaking English with an extremely thick, broad Scottish accent: loud, gravelly and raspy, hard rolled R's, bellowing like she is shouting across a glen, cackling with glee, fearless, furious and very funny.

dom.speaker: Dom
dom.description: Dom, a Mexican street racer in his forties who lives for his family, speaking English with a thick, warm Mexican Spanish accent: an extremely deep, gravelly bass voice, slow, calm and dramatic, rolling R's, a cool cartoon action hero.

cletus.speaker: Cletus
cletus.description: Cletus, a deep-backwoods Appalachian hillbilly tow-truck man: an extremely thick, twangy, nasal mountain drawl, high-pitched and giggly, fast-talking and hollering with glee, missing a few teeth, a cartoonish good ol' boy.
cletus.note: A designed Appalachian voice is in ok-samples3/_previews/15-Cletus-Appalachian-*.mp3 (not saved: the account is at its 10 custom-voice limit).

king-arthur.speaker: King Arthur
king-arthur.description: A pompous, regal English king on a quest: plummy received pronunciation, theatrical and noble, utterly serious about ridiculous things.

black-knight.speaker: Black Knight
black-knight.description: A stubborn English knight who refuses to admit he is beaten: gruff, booming, indignant.

french-taunter.speaker: French Taunter
french-taunter.description: An outrageously rude Frenchman shouting insults from a castle wall: exaggerated French accent, nasal, sneering, delighted with himself.

mr-white.speaker: Mr. White
mr-white.description: A cold, controlled, menacing middle-aged American man: quiet intensity, proud and precise, that can snap into a roar.

jesse.speaker: Jesse
jesse.role: Camper RV (second voice in the cab)
jesse.description: A young, twitchy American slacker who says "yo" a lot: excitable, cracking voice, very loud when happy.

german-tourist-in-the-back.speaker: German tourist (in the back)
german-tourist-in-the-back.role: Camper RV (a passenger, horn lines only)
german-tourist-in-the-back.description: A cheerful middle-aged German woman on holiday in the back of an RV: thick German accent, bright and bossy, shrieks at her husband Hans.

sal.speaker: Sal
sal.description: A hot-blooded Italian from Naples speaking English with a thick Italian accent: operatic, passionate, all hand gestures and "mamma mia".

vinnie.speaker: Vinnie
vinnie.description: A fast-talking Brooklyn cab driver: nasal New York accent, impatient, wisecracking.

mortimer.speaker: Mortimer
mortimer.description: A lugubrious English undertaker: very deep, slow, dry, funereal, faintly amused.

billy-ray.speaker: Billy-Ray
billy-ray.description: A loud Texas cowboy: big drawl, whooping, cheerful.

bazza.speaker: Bazza
bazza.description: A broad ocker Aussie bloke from the outback: laid-back, cheeky, beer-and-barbecue voice.

mireille.speaker: Mireille
mireille.description: A haughty Parisian woman: elegant French accent, bored and disdainful, sharp when angry.

angus.speaker: Angus
angus.description: A fiery Glaswegian: thick Scottish accent, rolling Rs, loud and cheerfully furious.

klaus.speaker: Klaus
klaus.description: A precise German engineer: clipped German accent, flat and analytical, outraged by inefficiency.

grandma-edna.speaker: Grandma Edna
grandma-edna.description: A tiny feisty American grandma: high, wavering, sweet voice with a savage streak.

chad.speaker: Chad
chad.description: A mellow Southern California surfer dude: slow, sun-baked, "duuude".

boris.speaker: Boris
boris.description: A huge deadpan Russian: deep voice, thick Russian accent, totally unbothered.

seamus.speaker: Seamus
seamus.description: A chatty, cheerful Irishman from Cork: quick lilting brogue, always about to laugh.

lars.speaker: Lars
lars.description: A polite, sing-song Swede: Swedish accent, mild and cheerful even when furious.

paco.speaker: Paco
paco.description: A flamboyant Spaniard from Seville: Castilian Spanish accent, passionate and theatrical.

kenji.speaker: Kenji
kenji.description: An intense young Japanese street racer: Japanese accent, quick, earnest, very dramatic about honour.

joaquim.speaker: Joaquim
joaquim.description: A party-loving Brazilian: Brazilian Portuguese accent, sunny, sing-song, football-commentator "Gooool".

nigel.speaker: Nigel
nigel.description: A cheeky East London Cockney geezer: dropped Hs, quick and chirpy.

boudreaux.speaker: Boudreaux
boudreaux.description: A Louisiana Cajun from the bayou: Cajun French-tinged drawl, rough and jolly.

papa-jacques.speaker: Papa Jacques
papa-jacques.description: Papa Jacques, a dramatic old French farmer from the countryside with an extremely thick, exaggerated French accent: theatrical, outraged, sighing and wailing about his ruined crops, nasal and expressive, a hilarious cartoon Frenchman.

uncle-bogdan.speaker: Uncle Bogdan
uncle-bogdan.role: Fuel tanker "Lyudmila" (talks on the CB radio)
uncle-bogdan.accent: comedic eastern european village (original, fictional village of Kartoshkovo)
uncle-bogdan.description: Uncle Bogdan, a cheerful, naive village truck driver in his forties from a made-up Eastern European village, speaking broken English with a very thick, comedic Slavic accent: warm, nasal and bright, rolled R's, wide open vowels, wildly over-enthusiastic and giggly, bursting with innocent pride. Original character, not an impression of any real person.

lulu.speaker: Lulu
lulu.description: Lulu, a hyperactive Hong Kong Chinese woman sports commentator in her thirties, speaking English with a very thick, exaggerated Cantonese accent. Shrieking, giggling, rapid-fire and wildly over the top, shouting Aiyaa and Jiayou at every crash, a cartoon character full of fun.
